snippet.title: Katherine & Joe Jackson Reflect on Michael Jackson’s Historic BMI Award (1990 Interview)
snippet.description:
In this rare 1990 interview, Katherine Jackson and Joe Jackson share heartfelt reflections following Michael Jackson receiving a prestigious honor from Broadcast Music, Inc. (BMI).

They discuss what the award meant for Michael as the first recipient of an honor named after him, highlighting his relentless work ethic and desire to positively influence music, culture, and the world. Joe Jackson emphasizes Michael’s vision, saying the world would be better if people truly understood his message.

The interview also offers a rare glimpse into Michael as a son—described as generous, loving, and deeply caring—and reveals the values behind the Jackson family’s success: hard work, discipline, love, and constant support.

Most touching of all, Katherine and Joe express pride not only in Michael’s achievements, but in all nine of their children—especially their strong values and staying away from drugs.

📌 This is a must-watch for fans who want to understand the family behind the legend.
